name: autoclip
description: AutoClip｜The open-source OpusClip alternative — local-first AI clipping & MCP server, zero subscriptions. 一个链接，一键出片。开源 AI 视频剪辑桌面工具，将播客、访谈、课程等长视频自动剪成短视频，生成字幕、封面和发布文案，适配抖音、小红书、TikTok、Reels 与 YouTube Shorts。
one_liner: A local-first AI tool that automatically turns long podcasts, interviews, or livestreams into short, captioned clips ready to post, without a paid subscription.
buyer: A solo podcaster, streamer, or small marketing agency managing client social accounts who needs daily short-form clips but has no video editor on staff.
business_use_cases: A social media manager runs client podcasts through it daily to produce a week of short-form clips in an afternoon.
A freelance video editor offers a cheaper 'AI-assisted clipping' service by using it to generate first drafts, then polishing manually.
An agency self-hosts it for clients who need clip generation but won't send raw footage to a third-party cloud service.

money_ideas.idea: A monthly 'clips as a service' subscription for podcasters and streamers
One-off batch clipping gigs for a backlog of existing footage

steal_this: Offer one local podcaster a free week of daily clips, then convert them to a flat monthly fee.
